entries.title: The first screen says welcome aboard Infinitary
entries.body: On a new setup, the first screen says Welcome aboard Infinitary, Captain. Your first mate asks to be set up on a computer that stays on, and says your other devices need that first mate awake. The subscription choices stay the same.

picture.alt: The first screen, with the first mate above Welcome aboard Infinitary, Captain, and a short line about the crew.

entries.title: The welcome card is titled How we work
entries.body: After you connect a subscription, the first card is titled How we work. It still walks through the same five parts, with the same three starters.

picture.alt: The How we work card, open on its first part, with Back, Next and three starters.
